title: Rotated sorted array search
statementMd:
A sorted array of distinct integers was rotated at an unknown pivot. Return the index of `target` or `-1`, in O(log n).

**Example:** `search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 0)` returns `4`.
hints: One half is always sorted; decide which side holds the target.
